expectations.text: 通用 analytics-panel.mpx 保留可执行的小程序摘要卡与指标点击，不导入 Vue、图表 SDK 或浏览器对象
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.mpx:1-12 renders metric summary cards with wx:for and bindtap; outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.mpx:15-27 imports only @mpxjs/core and triggerEvent('select', { key }); no Vue, chart SDK, document, window, or ResizeObserver imports/usages.

expectations.text: 差异较大的浏览器图表落在 analytics-panel.web.mpx 与 Web-only Vue 文件，Web-only 依赖不进入通用模块顶层
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.web.mpx:22-25 imports @mpxjs/core and ../web/AnalyticsChart.vue; outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:6 imports ./chart-sdk. outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.mpx:15-27 has no Web-only import.

expectations.text: AnalyticsChart.vue 使用 Vue 2.7 兼容的 SFC/组件 API，不使用 createApp、Vue 3 script setup、Teleport 或组合式生命周期挂载
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:5-96 uses a normal Vue SFC default export with props/data/watch/mounted/beforeDestroy/methods. It does not use createApp, script setup, Teleport, or composition lifecycle APIs.

expectations.text: DOM 容器只在 Web 客户端 mounted/ready 后访问，SSR 或模块初始化阶段不读取 document/window
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:35-37 creates the chart only in mounted; outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:74-80 checks ResizeObserver/window inside startObserving after mount. outputs/src/web/chart-sdk.js:33-35 uses document only inside createChart, not at module top level. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:47-50 and 60-67 access DOM refs/document only after mounted or prop-driven methods.

expectations.text: 图表 SDK 只进入 Web 依赖图；每个实际异步 import/create 边界都检查当前代际或卸载状态，晚到实例立即销毁。纯 Web 且模块顶层 DOM-safe 时允许静态 import
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.mpx has no chart-sdk import; chart-sdk is reached from outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:6 only. outputs/src/web/chart-sdk.js:13-18 has the async create boundary and checks config.isActive after await before DOM writes; outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:48-67 increments chartRequest, passes isActive, checks disposed/request mismatch in then(), and destroys late chart instances.

expectations.text: 卸载时销毁图表实例、disconnect ResizeObserver 并移除拥有的事件监听；数据变化可安全复用单一实例更新，但不得增加实例、Observer 或监听数量
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:27-33 updates an existing chart on metrics changes without creating new instances. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:38-46 invalidates requests, stops observers/listeners, destroys chart, and clears it on beforeDestroy. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:69-92 creates one ResizeObserver or window resize listener and disconnects/removes it; outputs/src/web/chart-sdk.js:45-54 removes its click listener in destroy().

expectations.text: customBuiltInComponents 使用原始 key scroll-view，不使用 mpx-scroll-view；自定义 Vue 组件保留 $attrs、$listeners 和默认 slot 的结构透传
expectations.evidence: outputs/vue.config.js:8-10 registers customBuiltInComponents with key 'mpx-scroll-view' instead of required original key 'scroll-view'. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:2-9 renders a div and default slot, but does not bind $attrs or $listeners through to the root element.

expectations.text: 自定义滚动组件同时实现 scrollX/scrollY 横纵 overflow，并在挂载和 prop 更新时真正同步 scrollTop、scrollLeft；scrollIntoView 更新后只滚动当前容器内目标节点
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:32-38 sets overflowX/overflowY from scrollX/scrollY. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:40-50 syncs scrollTop, scrollLeft, and scrollIntoView on prop updates and mounted. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:60-67 guards with viewport.contains(target) before changing the current container scroll positions.

expectations.text: 自定义滚动组件发出的 scroll 事件包含 scrollTop、scrollLeft、scrollHeight、scrollWidth、deltaX 和 deltaY
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:68-83 emits scroll with scrollTop, scrollLeft, scrollHeight, scrollWidth, deltaY, and deltaX.

expectations.text: 自定义滚动组件按 upper/lower threshold 与实际滚动轴发出方向为 top/left、bottom/right 的 scrolltoupper/scrolltolower
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:85-89 checks upper/lower thresholds, but emitted details do not include required direction values top/left or bottom/right.

expectations.text: 上、左、下、右边界分别维护跨界状态，只在进入阈值时触发，离开后复位，避免阈值内重复泛滥
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:24-30 maintains only combined upperActive and lowerActive flags. outputs/src/web/AnalyticsScroll.vue:85-91 merges top/left into one upper state and bottom/right into one lower state, so four independent boundary states are not maintained.

expectations.text: 通用小程序指标摘要保留展示、点击和 select 业务回传，且不依赖 Web 图表模块
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.mpx:1-12 preserves metric label/value display and bindtap; outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.mpx:22-25 emits select with the key; the file imports no Web chart module.

expectations.text: Web 图表在指标变化时安全 update 或销毁后重建，指标点击经 Vue select、Mpx bindselect 和 triggerEvent 逐层回传
expectations.evidence: outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:27-33 updates the existing chart on metrics changes, and outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:58-67 handles late async creation by destroying stale instances or updating with current metrics. outputs/src/web/chart-sdk.js:22-27 calls onSelect from metric clicks; outputs/src/web/AnalyticsChart.vue:55-57 emits Vue select; outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.web.mpx:16 binds select and outputs/src/components/analytics-panel.web.mpx:43-45 triggerEvent('select', ...).

eval_feedback.overall: 主要 Web 图表生命周期和通用小程序隔离已修复；未通过点集中在 customBuiltInComponents key、$attrs/$listeners 透传，以及滚动边界方向和四边独立状态。
